title: AcceptanceCriterion
description: A single testable condition that must be met for a user story to be accepted as complete

id.description: Unique identifier for the acceptance criterion

storyId.description: ID of the parent user story

description.description: Plain-language description of the acceptance condition

format.description: Format used to express the criterion

given.description: Gherkin Given clause (context/precondition) if format is gherkin

when.description: Gherkin When clause (action/trigger) if format is gherkin

then.description: Gherkin Then clause (expected outcome) if format is gherkin

order.description: Display order position within the parent story

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the criterion was created
